title: Chapter 1475 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens
content:
Chapter 1475 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens

Chapter 1475: Chapter 14: An Ant Beholds the Heavens

Having lost the consent of the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, acting in the past time and space will create various repercussions that will weigh heavily on Lin Yuan.

Over five hundred terrifying beings are nearly invincible in their respective time and space; their deaths would have an immense impact on the future. The overwhelming backlash no one can withstand. Without transcendence, Lin Yuan would absolutely not dare to do so.

"Go, go, go."

"Return, all of you."

Terrifying beings, one after another, immediately and without hesitation, follow the rejection of their current time-space, wishing to return to their original space-time.

In this way, it means failure in transcending tribulation, but it’s better than completely perishing here.

"Want to leave?"

Lin Yuan saw through the thoughts of over five hundred terrifying beings and gently closed his eyes.

"Heaven and earth as a prison."

When Lin Yuan opened his eyes again, the mark on his brow exploded suddenly, and the invisible energy began to spread and diffuse towards endless dimensional barriers.

At this moment, the endless dimensional barrier of the current time-space condensed like a prison.

Only entry, no exit.

Even terrifying beings of non-current time-space were locked here.

"No?!"

The faces of the terrifying beings changed dramatically, some directly annihilating their current main battle body.

However, even though the main battle body was annihilated, it left slight traces, swept by the invisible energy, which could also diffuse along these traces to the many timelines of past and future lifesaving means.

Swoosh.

The invisible energy rippled like waves, legendary lords of a hundred million tribulations and two hundred million tribulations couldn’t hold on for an instant, directly being completely erased, past, present, future, layers of time-space all erased.

Legendary lords close to three hundred million tribulations could hold on for a few breaths, but it was of no consequence, as after a few breaths, they were equally erased, past, present, future, layers of time-space all erased.

Over five hundred terrifying beings near the end of the road to transcendence proved far more difficult to deal with, but under the sweep of invisible energy gathered by the new Dao, annihilation was only a matter of time.

Lin Yuan sat high atop the space-time, the entire dimensional barrier below like an alchemy furnace, refining the legendary lords and terrifying beings.

...

Time-space shook, timelines twisted and collapsed.

A silver shadow followed the timeline, wanting to return to its original time-space.

"Finally passed the two hundred millionth tribulation."

A smile appeared on the face of the silver shadow: "I, Lord Wanwei, am now closer to transcendence."

The silver shadow, namely Lord Wanwei, had just gone to a distant future segment of time-space, slain the tribulation target, and completed the test imposed by the Supreme Rule. Now it was leaving the future time-space, returning to its original time-space.

Just then.

A segment of extremely chaotic vibrating time-space affected Lord Wanwei’s return direction, forcibly pulling it in.

Sinking into this extremely chaotic dark time-space, Lord Wanwei initially did not care too much, but with only slight observation, felt an unprecedented suffocation.

The entire time-space was completely sealed, and upon falling in, Lord Wanwei realized it had lost complete connection with its original time-space, unable to return.

What shocked Lord Wanwei even more was that this space-time was undergoing a fierce and gruesome massacre.

Many legendary lords not weaker than it were falling one after another, blood of carcasses scattering across the void.

Terrorizing existences with extremely horrifying aura were similarly rapidly perishing.

These terrifying beings had at least passed three hundred million tribulations, even three hundred million one thousand tribulations, three hundred million two thousand, approaching the end of the road to transcendence.

Yet still falling without resistance, perishing, extinguished.

Lord Wanwei descended at an exceptionally fortunate position, temporarily untouched by the invisible energy, standing in the corner of the battlefield, surrounded by countless corpses, legendary lords of million tribulations cheap as ants.

Lord Wanwei struggled within its gaze, raising its neck with difficulty, looking towards the high place of time-space.

There, cross-legged, sat a silhouette, the source of all slaughter on the battlefield.

Lord Wanwei dumbly gazed upward at that figure, as if an ant seeing the vast sky.
